API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPrivileged Console ManagementCreates a list of privileged consoles for the specified privileged portal and customer.
Creates a list of privileged consoles for the specified privileged portal and customer.
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/praConsole/bulk

Creates a list of privileged consoles for the specified privileged portal and customer.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.
